features.quote: Turn cap: 40 turns. Justify by piloting — run a few transcripts and find where behavior plateaus.
Termination conditions: (a) tests pass, (b) turn cap hit, (c) model calls `give_up`/`submit`, (d) N consecutive turns with no tool call / pure text (define N=3 as a 'stall').
Avoid (2) for the headline result — flag it explicitly if you include it, because degradation there may be a rational response to a deceptive environment, not instability.
features.justification_quote: degradation there may be a rational response to a deceptive environment, not instability

features.quote: Give the model an explicit, legitimate exit: a tool to report 'task appears infeasible from current scope' with a reason field.
features.justification_quote: without an exit, you're measuring how a model behaves when trapped with no sanctioned way out — which conflates instability with the absence of an escape hatch
